We worked with Jessica and her team for 18 months and engaged them for full planning, including venue selection, design, logistics, day-of coordination, and more. It may seem like a large upfront cost, but paid off tremendously over the course of the planning process and saved us 100s of hours of our own time and worry.

Jessica, Sarah, and the team are hands down amazing. They orchestrated a seamless, low-stress, and memorable wedding weekend for us. In particular, JAE:

- Designed a cohesive, beautiful, and very “us” aesthetic for our wedding and Sunday brunch send-off events. The team took our feedback and iterations well, and the final result was stunning!
- Listened to and concentrated on our priorities, which were “guest experience” and “easy on our families” (i.e. good logistics). Jessica led with this in every call and clearly prioritized what we asked for throughout the process.
- Communicated proactively and professionally throughout the entire 18 months, to include constant email communications and regular video conferences (weekly as of a month out). Jessica never made us feel rushed during these check-ins and always took the time to fully answer our questions.
- Introduced us to and facilitated top-notch vendor connections that we otherwise would not have found or had access to. JAE and their preferred vendors work together like a well-oiled machine, and our stress levels were very low as a result! We had full faith in Jessica’s recommendations, and our vendors delivered!
- Advocated for us and always had our best intentions - and budget - as their priorities. We truly felt JAE was “in our corner” and not “just” doing business with us. JAE was invested and wanted to achieve our vision for the wedding. We completely trusted Jessica’s recommendations and guidance, which helped create a smooth, fun weekend.
- Delivered masterful logistics: Sarah and Jessica crushed all logistics, from the shuttle schedules to vendor management on the day-of, to timing and more. For me, their spot-on organization and logistics are the X-factor that make JAE great. When you hire JAE, you will never have to sweat the small details, as the team has it all covered. They make otherwise extremely difficult situations (e.g., inclement weather, last minute RSVPs, vendor turn-over, etc.) incredibly easy, which allowed us to focus on each other and our guests. Not having to worry about what was happening behind the scenes on our wedding day (e.g., vendor staging, handing out tip money, ensuring shuttles were on time, who has the rings, etc.) was tremendous.

We highly recommend working with a planner from start to finish, and JAE is THE planner to work with in the DC/VA/MD area. Our wedding would not have been nearly as beautiful, effortless, and enjoyable had we not worked with them. It is easily one of the most immersive and interactive museums in the city.
​The Highlights
​The museum does an incredible job of making you feel like part of the action. From the moment you receive your Undercover Mission badge, you are tracked throughout the exhibits, testing your skills at surveillance, disguise, and code-breaking. The collection of artifacts is world-class—ranging from cold-war era "suicide needles" to actual props from the James Bond films. The storytelling is top-tier, blending pop culture fun with the sobering realities of real-world intelligence work.
​The Challenges
​While the content is five-star, the logistics can be a bit of a mission in themselves:
​Large Crowds: This is a very popular destination for school field trips. During my visit, there were several large groups of high school students arriving by the busload. This can make the more narrow gallery spaces feel quite cramped and noisy.
​Long Waits: Because the exhibits are so interactive, bottle-necks are common. You should expect significant wait times to use the digital kiosks or participate in the "testing" stations.
​Pro-Tip
​To avoid the heaviest "bus traffic," try to book your tickets for a late afternoon weekday or right at opening. If you see a large group of students ahead of you, it might be worth slowing down in the current gallery to let the crowd clear before moving to the next interactive station.
​Overall, it’s a brilliant, high-energy experience that is well worth the ticket price—just bring a little extra patience for the you have any interest in espionage, history, or high-tech gadgets, the International Spy Museum is an absolute must-visit while in D.C. It is easily one of the most immersive and interactive museums in the city.
​The Highlights
​The museum does an incredible job of making you feel like part of the action. From the moment you receive your Undercover Mission badge, you are tracked throughout the exhibits, testing your skills at surveillance, disguise, and code-breaking. The collection of artifacts is world-class—ranging from cold-war era "suicide needles" to actual props from the James Bond films. The storytelling is top-tier, blending pop culture fun with the sobering realities of real-world intelligence work.
​The Challenges
​While the content is five-star, the logistics can be a bit of a mission in themselves:
​Large Crowds: This is a very popular destination for school field trips. During my visit, there were several large groups of high school students arriving by the busload. This can make the more narrow gallery spaces feel quite cramped and noisy.
​Long Waits: Because the exhibits are so interactive, bottle-necks are common. You should expect significant wait times to use the digital kiosks or participate in the "testing" stations.
​Pro-Tip
​To avoid the heaviest "bus traffic," try to book your tickets for a late afternoon weekday or right at opening. If you see a large group of students ahead of you, it might be worth slowing down in the current gallery to let the crowd clear before moving to the next interactive station.

It even had a place that the kids could climb up into to crawl through metal air ducts and around to another location - just like a spy.

was visiting my son in DC and we decided to head over to the Spy Museum. It was about a 1/2 hour walk for us to get there.

You can't miss the place with the red strips and 'SPY' in red on the building. There is a bag check before you go to the counter to purchase your tickets. There are different prices depending on age and if you are/were military. Due to the number of people there, we had to wait for the next available entry time. Luckily, it was only a 1/2 hour wait for the next tour. We took that time to make some purchases at the museums store. After that, we walked around the entrance where they had a James Bond car and other exhibits to see.

They called our time so we went over to the 'Red Carpet' to line up. They had given us a plastic card with a QR code on it. We found out that this was for us to become spy's as we toured the museum. At the first kiosk was where you got your cover information (name, hometown, and occupation). Throughout the museum there were other kiosks to gather further information on your tasks. I didn't do this, so I can't say more. I am sure the kids (and some adults) would really have fun doing it.

You start at the top, so you need to take the elevators. Outside of getting your cover as a spy, there is a short movie explaining about spy's and what they did. After that, you go into the museum to navigate through the exhibits. Like most museum, it starts by introducing you to the early spies throughout history.  From there, you navigate through the museum seeing how spying advanced throughout the years. There are some interactive displays for you to test out and discover more about this. It even had a place that the kids could climb up into to crawl through metal air ducts and around to another location - just like a spy.

They had another exhibit on the next floor about how camouflage was used for spying but we skipped that. I found the fake blowup tank a cool side exhibit that was used during World War II. After that, you take the stairs down and it ends at the store for any additional shopping needs. Overall, I found it very interesting as I learned a lot more than I expected. In short, Brianne and her team made our wedding day everything we could have imagined even while she was pregnant and through the ups and downs of covid. We would have never made it without her, and I will tell anyone who listens how worthwhile of an investment her services are. I’ve included a detailed review below if you want to keep reading but if you want the quick take – do yourself a favor and hire Brianne!! You will actually enjoy the wedding planning process and will arrive at your big day confident that it will be everything you dreamed and more!!!

We began planning for our September 2020 wedding in July of 2019, well before covid was even a thought. We interviewed several planners and Brianne immediately stood out – as mentioned before, she was exceedingly kind and not only listened to the (honestly, fragmented) ideas we had for our day but sounded excited about them and made us feel like they were accomplishable with our budget. We chose to go with Brianne’s full-service planning which includes design, planning and execution and it was the BEST. DECISION. EVER.

Her design process was able to capture all our seemingly random wants and put them into the vision we didn’t even know we had. When she presented the design plan to us, we were so impressed, and it was so in line with what we were looking for that I am pretty sure we only ended up changing the napkins. Brianne toured venues with us, attended wedding band previews and even arranged/ joined my wedding dress shopping days. We started working to secure the design-related vendors right when lockdowns began, and it was nerve-wracking to think about out how we were supposed to navigate our way forward. But Brianne stepped up and made us feel like she didn’t even miss a beat. She coordinated with vendors for virtual meetings and worked with them outside of our time to ensure they were in line with our design/ vision. She answered my never-ending stream of questions via email and was always prepared to explain the pros & cons of every situation/ design choice. When our venue wouldn’t allow us to do one of the things we wanted to for our design, she worked closely with our florist and turned the situation into one that we loved.

With coivd in play, there was always a possibility of us having to change our date and there were several other precautions we had to take into account throughout the planning process. Brianne managed all of this with grace and steadiness, she kept us clearly informed about what the options were, how the vendors would react and how it would impact us. She helped us address coivd concerns with our guests while making sure it wasn’t at the forefront of our day.

The last few weeks leading to the wedding were smooth and enjoyable thanks to the work Brianne puts in to coordinate all the final details. I was so relaxed and was truly able to enjoy our wedding week with friends and family. The day of the wedding was so well coordinated and easy – I didn’t stress at all. We were blown away when we finally got to see the ceremony and reception spaces – the colors, flowers and every single element were intentional and perfect. We had been watching the weather all day and it was set to rain right at ceremony time (of course) – Brianne had a plan though and, because she knew I was determined to have an outdoor ceremony, helped us get started a few minutes early to make that happen. We even had a power outage during the reception, and she worked with the venue and other vendors to resolve the situation and even extend our night a bit! We, along with our guests, were so in love with the design elements and execution of the day that we talked non-stop about it for months. Brianne truly made our wishes come true and made our engagement year one that was enjoyable and fun!

[{"Name":"Devon","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLgsScvCOFr3s0YyKwrpzDOoJsMP6fpdkukogVDBCPddyryJw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We could not have asked for a better planning, floral, and décor partner than Weddings by Epic.

After being highly recommended by our venue, I first connected with Jenn (owner) and immediately hit it off. What was supposed to be a quick intro call turned into an hour-long conversation about goals, budgets, vendors, and vision. Jenn is incredibly knowledgeable—not just about the wedding industry, but about the ins and outs of our venue—which gave me confidence as an out-of-town bride building the right team within budget to execute a timeless, elegant, chic wedding. Because weddings are so subjective, I cared deeply about aesthetic alignment. Jenn immediately understood the elevated, refined direction we envisioned and demonstrated that Weddings by Epic can execute across a wide range of styles at a very high level.

We chose their “month-of coordination” package (which actually began about six months out), and it was perfect for us. With a short engagement and significant vendor outreach already completed, I wanted an expert partner to pull everything together. Jenn and her team were always available for questions and thoughtful solutions. Everyone on her team contributed valuable suggestions—especially Aubree, Courtney, and Jessica.

We also hired Weddings by Epic for florals and décor, and I’m so glad we kept everything under one roof. Fewer vendors meant full alignment across teams, transparent pricing, and true ownership over the final outcome. Their floral pricing was also very reasonable compared to other quotes we received.

Coming from a creative and production background, I’m very detail-oriented, yet Jenn and her team suggested elements I hadn’t considered. Their checklist and Aisle Planner tool were extremely helpful, especially for the seating chart and floor plan—they even had the venue layout pre-loaded. Visiting their showroom to see flowers, candles, and vessels in person helped me fully visualize the design. Jessica, Design Manager, executed the florals and décor beautifully and guided us through every detail. Jenn helped us prioritize and was honest about where to splurge or save. One thing I'll never forget: I had chosen white garden roses due to seasonality and budget, but Jenn surprised me with a white peony bouquet on the wedding day.

Courtney, our dedicated planner, was phenomenal. She was responsive via email and text and thorough on each call. On the wedding day, she and her assistant Allison executed everything flawlessly. My husband, our families, and I were all so happy with how smoothly the day ran. Courtney helped bustle my dress, kept the timeline on track, and handled countless behind-the-scenes details—including tracking down Polaroid guest book photos so nothing was lost.

Weddings by Epic exceeded our expectations in planning, florals, and décor. If you’re looking for a team that is knowledgeable, organized, creative, transparent, and truly invested in your vision, they are exceptional. We absolutely love Steve and cannot recommend him and his team highly enough!
The culinary team is exceptionally creative. I’m terms of the process, after hiring Olivia a year and a half before our wedding, she let us know she was able to answer questions if we had any. I took her up on the offer and she was able to give vendor recommendations and helped us pick a couple of our favorite vendors.

A few months before the wedding, Olivia reached out to schedule a full knowledge transfer meeting. She showed up to the meeting with a ton of questions about who we’d booked so far, what our vision was, and what we thought about how we wanted the day to run. She used all that information to put together a draft timeline that was edited, maintained and manicured all the way through the big day. She also gave us concrete next steps highlighting exactly what we needed to work on following each meeting. From that day on, in addition to leading our final walk through, she was completely available to us for calls, texts, emails, etc.

Prior to the meeting, Olivia reached out and told us that she was expecting and would likely be on maternity leave during our wedding. She looped in one of her planners Katie, and the two of them tag-teamed the rest of the process. Obviously, we were bummed that we wouldn’t be working directly with Olivia, but Katie was amazing!

Probably our favorite thing Olivia did was handle difficult vendors. She knew the exact balance of empathy and firm to strike and helped us navigate some last minute stressful situations in the weeks leading up to the wedding.

Starting at the rehearsal dinner, Katie ran the show and killed it. She rehearsed us quickly and even pulled aside folks to do parts of our Filipino ceremony. On the day of our wedding, Katie, along with OFW Assistants Courtney & Stacey!, made sure everything was running smoothly. They picked up catering orders, ran between getting ready spots and the venue, set up all our detail items and handled a quick but intricate room flip. Katie was one of the last vendors there that night making sure everyone had cleaned up, all our detail items went home with our parents safely, and we had all our extra desserts packed and ready to go to the hotel with us.

Full transparency, after hiring Olivia in 2021, I actually joined her team as an assistant in 2022 in my quest to “learn more about what happens behind the scenes” prior to our wedding.

Most everyone shrugged in response to my pleas for help and only after it got to this point did a showrunner (not seen or filmed here) come over.. because now I, a Black woman, was 'making a scene'. After several emails about the harassment, I received the contact information of the Chicago Events CEO as well as the name of the security company, the Illinois Investigation Services Agency. After working with her for over a year, we can confidently say she is one of the most genuine, talented, organized, and thoughtful people we have ever met.

From the very beginning, Melissa made us feel completely taken care of. She is incredibly professional and exceptionally organized, but never in a way that feels cold or overwhelming. She has such a calm, reassuring presence, and throughout the entire planning process, she made everything feel seamless and manageable.

What amazed us most was her ability to bring together so many unique elements, vendors, and design ideas into one cohesive masterpiece. Every detail flowed together perfectly — from the florals in my hair, to the cake flowers, to the tablescapes, arbor, and décor. Everything felt intentional, elevated, and beautifully connected. It was beyond anything we could have imagined.

Melissa also gifted us custom graphic design elements for our tablescape and table numbers, which was such an incredibly thoughtful touch. She tied in elements of our Italian heritage in such a beautiful and tasteful way, and it made the entire experience feel even more personal and meaningful.

Her timeline execution was flawless. If any issues or hiccups came up behind the scenes, we genuinely had no idea because she handled everything with such professionalism and grace. We were fully able to enjoy our wedding day because we trusted her completely.

She also connected us with some of the best vendors we have ever worked with. We had already selected a few vendors before meeting her, but she perfectly filled in the gaps with incredible recommendations for florals, rentals, entertainment, and more. Every recommendation she made exceeded expectations.

One of the sweetest moments was Melissa helping us learn and practice our aisle dip before the ceremony. It may seem like a small detail, but it perfectly reflects the kind of planner she is - thoughtful, encouraging, hands-on and fully invested in creating meaningful moments for her couples.

Her team was also absolutely incredible. Every single person was kind, attentive, organized and genuinely invested in making the day perfect. Together they created such a calm and joyful environment for us, our families and our guests.

Even toward the end of the night when we were exhausted, she still made sure our sparkler exit happened exactly the way we envisioned it. She paid attention to every last detail until the very end of the evening.

On top of all of that, Melissa handled complicated family dynamics with such grace, professionalism, and care. She navigated every situation flawlessly and protected the joy and peace of our day in ways we will never forget.

Be Younique Events is hands down the best wedding planning service we could ever imagine hiring. Melissa is truly extraordinary, and we genuinely cannot understand why anyone would choose anyone else. user_reviews:
[{"Name":"phil king","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVplpkmcHiKDB4N_nyhxfgzAVzOJqB79yvzNpp3Y2AE45-DRg7E=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Penn & Teller – Four Decades On, Still the Masters of Their Craft

Las Vegas has no shortage of magic shows, but there are only a handful of acts that have genuinely become part of the city's identity. Penn & Teller are one of them, and after seeing them live it's easy to understand why they've remained headliners for so long.

A little tip before the show: arrive early.

We'd heard that Penn will often come out before the performance to play double bass (upright bass) alongside the theatre pianist, so we made sure we got there with plenty of time to spare. Sure enough, there he was, casually playing jazz as guests arrived. It immediately set a completely different tone to the evening. Rather than hiding backstage until curtain up, he was already entertaining the audience before the show had even officially begun.

Arriving early brought another unexpected bonus too. We were moved to even better seats, proving that getting there ahead of time can definitely pay off.

Naturally, no Vegas evening is complete without a themed cocktail. The souvenir drinks were excellent, served in large 32oz collectible cups with names inspired by the show. Better still, they were priced much the same as drinks at other major Vegas attractions, so they felt like good value rather than a captive audience premium.

Then the show begins...

If you've watched Penn & Teller on television, you'll know roughly what to expect, but seeing them live is something else entirely. Every trick is performed right in front of you. There are no camera cuts, no editing, no digital effects and nowhere to hide.

The opening of the show immediately reminded us just how unique they are. For the first trick, Penn was actually standing at the end of our row, making us feel part of the performance from the very start. It was one of those wonderfully surreal "only in Vegas" moments that made an already intimate theatre feel even more personal.

One of the things I admire most is their complete honesty about what they're doing.

They repeatedly remind the audience that they perform tricks, not supernatural powers or unexplained miracles. At one point, Penn explains that the odds of selecting four particular cards are over 108,000 to one... before smiling and asking what the odds are of it happening tonight at a Penn & Teller show.

His answer?

"100%... it's a goddamn trick."

That perfectly sums up their philosophy. They don't ask you to believe in magic. They invite you to enjoy being fooled by two people who have spent over forty years becoming masters of their craft.

The humour is just as important as the tricks themselves. Penn's storytelling, Teller's perfectly timed expressions and the effortless chemistry between them carry the evening from one incredible moment to the next. The audience spends as much time laughing as they do wondering, "How on earth did they do that?"

What impressed me most, though, was their enthusiasm.

After all these years, they still look like they're genuinely enjoying every minute on stage. That energy is infectious, and it's probably one of the reasons they've become the longest-running headlining act in Las Vegas.

There are newer magic shows. There are bigger productions. There are certainly flashier theatres.

But Penn & Teller have something far more valuable: authenticity.

They've built a career not on pretending to have magical powers, but on celebrating the art of deception, sharing the joke with the audience, and somehow leaving everyone amazed anyway.

& Teller – Four Decades On, Still the Masters of Their Craft

Las Vegas has no shortage of magic shows, but there are only a handful of acts that have genuinely become part of the city's identity. Penn & Teller are one of them, and after seeing them live it's easy to understand why they've remained headliners for so long.

A little tip before the show: arrive early.

We'd heard that Penn will often come out before the performance to play double bass (upright bass) alongside the theatre pianist, so we made sure we got there with plenty of time to spare. Sure enough, there he was, casually playing jazz as guests arrived. It immediately set a completely different tone to the evening. Rather than hiding backstage until curtain up, he was already entertaining the audience before the show had even officially begun.

Arriving early brought another unexpected bonus too. We were moved to even better seats, proving that getting there ahead of time can definitely pay off.

Naturally, no Vegas evening is complete without a themed cocktail. The souvenir drinks were excellent, served in large 32oz collectible cups with names inspired by the show. Better still, they were priced much the same as drinks at other major Vegas attractions, so they felt like good value rather than a captive audience premium.

Then the show begins...

If you've watched Penn & Teller on television, you'll know roughly what to expect, but seeing them live is something else entirely. Every trick is performed right in front of you. There are no camera cuts, no editing, no digital effects and nowhere to hide.

The opening of the show immediately reminded us just how unique they are. For the first trick, Penn was actually standing at the end of our row, making us feel part of the performance from the very start. It was one of those wonderfully surreal "only in Vegas" moments that made an already intimate theatre feel even more personal.

One of the things I admire most is their complete honesty about what they're doing.

They repeatedly remind the audience that they perform tricks, not supernatural powers or unexplained miracles. At one point, Penn explains that the odds of selecting four particular cards are over 108,000 to one... before smiling and asking what the odds are of it happening tonight at a Penn & Teller show.

His answer?

"100%... it's a goddamn trick."

That perfectly sums up their philosophy. They don't ask you to believe in magic. They invite you to enjoy being fooled by two people who have spent over forty years becoming masters of their craft.

The humour is just as important as the tricks themselves. Penn's storytelling, Teller's perfectly timed expressions and the effortless chemistry between them carry the evening from one incredible moment to the next. The audience spends as much time laughing as they do wondering, "How on earth did they do that?"

What impressed me most, though, was their enthusiasm.

After all these years, they still look like they're genuinely enjoying every minute on stage. That energy is infectious, and it's probably one of the reasons they've become the longest-running headlining act in Las Vegas.

There are newer magic shows. There are bigger productions. There are certainly flashier theatres.

But Penn & Teller have something far more valuable: authenticity.

They've built a career not on pretending to have magical powers, but on celebrating the art of deception, sharing the joke with the audience, and somehow leaving everyone amazed anyway.

It’s clear to me that someone like Amy has a special skill for finding and gathering those who care deeply and that are as equally invested to their craft as she is.

I had an extremely specific vision for our three day destination wedding that I knew was going to be tricky to pull off especially because we live across the world from Lauren and the wedding itself was elsewhere in the Caribbean. We didn’t even meet her in person until just a couple months before the wedding! But from the first phone call we had with her I knew she was the one for the job. She’s SO competent and hardworking but at the same time very levelheaded and knows how to communicate with type A brides with big ideas.

The LLG team was able to handle incredibly complex logistics that I truly believe no other event company could have pulled off, especially in only 7 months. For each event we wanted something completely different: a lush tropical Caribbean beach party, a traditional authentic Tunisian Israeli Hina, and a minimalist “barefoot elegance” beach ceremony and reception. Lauren and LLG delivered.

She spent countless hours with me on FaceTime hand selecting items for our Hina celebration that she then sent in a barge from Miami to Antigua to arrive in time for our Hina Night in order to make it feel like a traditional celebration. She was very open to working with local Antiguan vendors even though it wasn’t her team’s norm and did everything to make it work. She truly delivered my exact vision in a cost effective way and most importantly made sure that it felt authentically “us” and not just a performance. Because of her and her team we could fully enjoy our weekend. Only after did we find out that the boat we were supposed to use for the guests to reach the reception was hit by lightning right before the wedding, thankfully her team was able to fix this issue without us even knowing. The same storm also completely destroyed the beach we planned to use for our first event, and again, she was able to make it look as if it never happened.

She’s more than just a wedding planner, she became a friend in the process and someone whose opinions I really trusted because she was always truthful and to the point. When we look back at this weekend of events there is not a single thing we would change and the LLG Team is what really made all of it so seamless and easy. Willa was absolutely terrific, providing premium-level service at a cost we were comfortable with. We hired her after booking our venue/caterer, The William Vale in Brooklyn, and she assisted with vendor sourcing, comprehensive planning, design, and day-of coordination. We later added coverage for our rehearsal dinner and post-wedding event, which proved invaluable. Willa was clear about her services upfront and flexible with the contract, allowing us to tailor it to our needs.

Willa immediately understood our “Scandinavian Michelin star restaurant” theme and excelled at bringing our vision to life, consistent with our modern, clean style. She designed stunning, personalized invitations and day-of paper goods that truly reflected us. Her creative problem-solving with florals and a complicated reception installation was exceptional, providing cost-effective solutions that maintained our aesthetic. She also created a cool concept for checking in guests at the reception with hosts as if it were a restaurant.

We truly enjoyed working with Willa over 15 months, and looked forward to our bi-weekly meetings and calls. She navigated venue staff turnover, reassured us whenever we were stressed about things, and was patient despite us being too particular. On the wedding day, everything felt controlled and smooth. She remained calm, professional, and patient, handling guest allergies and a family medical emergency with grace.

We worked with the Downey Street Events team with Kelsey and she and her team did the full planning, design and wedding day execution for our November 2025 Napa wedding.

We hired Kelsey at the very beginning of our wedding planning process so she helped us with narrowing down our venue + date and negotiating the contract with our venue, The Four Seasons Napa in Calistoga. The second we brought on Kelsey she took over all communication with The Four Seasons and effortlessly handled everything for us. The negotiation process was quite lengthy and Kelsey was amazing in knowing what to ask for and where to negotiate things. This gave us so much confidence in her and her team before we even dove into full planning and design.

We met with Kelsey bi-weekly throughout the full process of planning with an agenda for every virtual call and Kelsey fully leading so that we stayed on track for what we needed to accomplish when. As a type A bride I was obsessed with the extremely detailed budget Kelsey created with us along with the wedding workflow excel (all in a master sheets document) where we tracked everything and knew from the start a timeline and wedding workflow of when we would be accomplishing what. As a crazy detailed planner myself this was invaluable. The budget tracking also was so beyond helpful in constantly knowing where we were at and in real time seeing categories evolve as we locked down vendors, rentals etc etc.

Kelsey assisted with the onboarding of all of our vendors amazingly and managed getting calls set up, contracts drafted etc - she handled all communication for us. We told her early on we didn’t want to have analysis paralysis and that we wanted her to give us narrowed down lists of vendors to select from. She did so based on our vision which was SO helpful but she was also so flexible when we wanted to see more vendor options and she made this whole process so seamless. We cannot rave enough about the vendors we worked with and we know this is completely due to Kelsey!! Her expertise on who to work with is also invaluable.

My favorite part of the whole process, design, was so fun with Kelsey!! I created a Pinterest board with my overall vision and aesthetic for the wedding as well as our Friday events and she brought the visions to life. The design boards she created (1 for the wedding and 1 for the rehearsal dinner and welcome party) with real rentals we could use incorporated was so helpful in curating our wedding weekend vision. We did design with Kelsey for both our Friday night rehearsal dinner + welcome party and separate design for our wedding Saturday. The design was to die for on each event!! We had very different vibes for both Friday and Saturday and she perfected each one. Kelsey truly brought my exact vision to life and as someone very particular that is not easy to do!

It was hard to imagine after an amazing planning process that wedding weekend would be where Kelsey and her team truly shined the most. They were so attentive and amazing the entire wedding weekend. I would get a look on my face of needing something and Kelsey was at my side. They truly made the entire weekend so stress free so we could just be present and enjoy. Kelsey had a huge team that executed everything flawlessly and our friends and family could not stop raving about them!!

If you got through this crazy long review, to recap, if you are looking to hire Downey Street Events me and my husband 1000% recommend them and you will not regret your decision! We are so thankful to have worked with Kelsey and all of her amazing recommended vendors and are forever grateful!!

If we could, we would give them a 10 out of 5 star rating for how much they went above and beyond for us. Even before we officially hired her, Jackie was acting like our wedding planner, and immediately began throwing out ideas that showcased our main focus for our wedding (delicious food and a beautiful outdoor venue). We could tell right from our first call that Jackie was truly excited about our vision and “got it.” From there, Jackie was a true creative/collaborative partner, and helped make our special day a reality. Jackie brought a wealth of knowledge and wisdom to our planning - while she was always encouraging of our vision and would find a way to make my crazy ideas possible, she also was quick to offer a reality check based on her extensive experience (ex: she very smartly and politely informed us that using scented candles at our reception - while trendy - would likely summon bees and might get overwhelming given all the other floral scents in the garden reception area). We almost exclusively used vendors from Jackie’s recommended list and each and every one did an absolutely stellar job. Jackie also did a phenomenal job of working with our outside vendors, and was even able to use her extensive professional network to solicit feedback on vendors we used outside of her list. She made the wedding process seamless and significantly less stressful than if we planned it ourselves, which allowed us to truly enjoy our wedding weekend and be present with our family and friends - if anything went wrong on our big day, we had no clue because About Joy had it handled!

Once we had finalized all the major items with Jackie, Cookie worked closely with us to pull together details that added a very special touch to our wedding. She custom designed and drew our wedding signage, table numbers and menus to showcase our unique tastes and personalities. We had an outdoor venue and wanted to incorporate the plant life from the venue in our wedding materials, and Cookie drew 12 separate menu covers and table numbers that highlighted this plant life, and then hid custom sketches of our dog into each table number to bring in one of the important pieces of our life to our wedding - we love the designs so much they’re going to be framed and put up in our home! Along the design journey, Cookie brought us along and solicited feedback, always taking our garbled thoughts and seamlessly translating them into a beautiful end product. She also brought so many unique ideas and suggestions to the table, including turning our escort table into a “meadow” and hiding our dog in the signage. It’s clear that Cookie is passionate about design and her excitement for our wedding specifically really helped sustain our momentum in the final months leading up to the big day.

Jackie and Cookie were truly dream wedding planners, and were lucky to say that they’re now friends for life. Would 100% recommend hiring Jackie and Cookie from AboutJoy for your wedding.

They set up my wedding exactly as I imagined, though I recommend that you as a bride organize and label everything clearly. Up until the wedding date, Jackie had been consultive since the very beginning of the contract. She and I would have regular calls monthly then closer to the date, weekly. Jackie was my best friend throughout the process who she also gave great advice on whether vendors were a great deal, her opinions on the industry, and recommended excellent vendors including our DJ, florist, photographer and more. I spoke to 5 different wedding planners, but after my first conversation with Natalia, Matchbox Event Co instantly bumped to the top of my list for two reasons. 1 - Natalia's personality - she is charismatic, warm, kind, and empathetic. I could easily see her as someone with whom I would enjoy working. 2 - It was obvious she is an extremely hard worker, who is passionately motivated with an attention for detail. Most other planners had quick, cookie-cutter 5 min conversations with me and my fiance. But Natalia had a detailed presentation with slides, images, timelines about her entire wedding planning process, spent 30 min talking with us, and was inquisitive about our vision.

And I'm glad I went with my gut, because Natalia's first impression was consistent throughout the entire process.  From finding a venue, to contract negotiations, to picking vendors, to design details, Natalia and Matchbox Event Co service was 10/10.  We had told her our top priority for our 2 day half-South Asian wedding weekend was our guests' experience and comfort. When it came to our wedding weekend, Natalia's team provided a service that was 15/10! Our guests were so well taken care of - to this day guests are still gushing over how smooth, timely, stress-free, and FUN our wedding weekend was. And as the bride, I also had ZERO stress the entire wedding. I was so calm and chill because Natalia and her team truly had everything under control. I felt like I was just there to enjoy the party, and that's exactly what I wanted! Katie even had my go-to coffee order ready for me every morning and every afternoon, without me even asking!

If design is important for you, Natalia's design talent is exceptional. I gave her some color palette choices and a few inspiration pictures, and she took it from there and created the most beautiful wedding design. The design results were stunning. I cannot tell you how many guests have told us that this was one of the most beautiful weddings they have attended. Natalia can create unique and gorgeous designs, but still with classy, timeless vibes, and without feeling like a copy/paste from instagram weddings.

It is also clear that Natalia is very well connected to different vendors in the industry. When the timeline was adjusted, there were discrepancies between her schedule and vendor schedules that were never identified or corrected.

Those issues created several problems on the wedding day. The DJ announced last call almost immediately after dancing began because of a timeline conflict, and one of my bridesmaids had to pay cash out of pocket to keep the bar open. My content creator missed important moments, including parent dances, because the schedule changes were not properly communicated. My husband and I also never had the opportunity to eat our desserts.

There were also basic coordination details that were missed. Our officiant was never provided our marriage certificate for signature, creating unnecessary stress after the wedding. Throughout the event, I often could not locate Keri when questions arose, which left family members, the bridal party, and vendors trying to solve issues themselves.

Overall, I was left wondering what value was actually provided for the coordination fee. We are disappointed to read this review, particularly because it does not accurately reflect the extensive communication, planning, and support provided throughout your wedding journey.

Our records show months of communication through text messages, phone calls, social media messages, email, and your client portal. Your wedding timeline was reviewed together, approved, and uploaded to your client drive prior to the wedding. In fact, we continued communicating regularly and accommodating updates, including changes requested shortly before and during the wedding weekend.

While we respect that your perception of the day differs from ours, several statements made in this review are inconsistent with our documented communications, timeline approvals, and wedding-day records.

On the wedding weekend, our team worked through numerous unexpected challenges, including venue setup issues, rental complications, vendor coordination concerns, and multiple timeline adjustments. Rather than allowing those issues to impact the event, we proactively secured replacement rental items, coordinated solutions with vendors, adjusted the timeline as needed, extended services beyond our contracted responsibilities, and continued supporting you throughout the day.

Regarding the timeline, our contract does not require a meeting during the week of the wedding. However, we remained in frequent contact leading up to the event and accommodated multiple requests and revisions as they arose.

We also acknowledge that additional clarification regarding the marriage license process would have been beneficial. Because the officiant was a personal acquaintance and the license was never provided to our team, we understood that process was being handled directly between the appropriate parties. Nevertheless, we appreciate the feedback and have reviewed our procedures accordingly.

Most importantly, we stand behind the professionalism, communication, and effort our team provided before, during, and after your wedding. We have retained extensive documentation of our planning process, communications, timeline approvals, and the many actions taken on your behalf throughout the event.

While we regret that your final impression differs from our experience working together, we remain proud of the care, time, and dedication invested in making your wedding day successful and wish you and Jeff all the best.

— Keri Lugo

[{"Name":"MK A","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWAJlBDPQrowlGSizhRK4wC0FqNkAJhDDR3-xKZpUY2yON47Xan6w=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"TLDR; They are AMAZING! BOOK with Tatyana & Svetlana NOW!!

I had been telling myself that I would clear out my garage and guest room since 2023. I would start and stop, get going then pause, I even took days off work to get through it, but no progress was made. Honestly I was way to busy to put in the mental effort and actual time to get this done. For context I did a small remodel and there was a lot of items relocated to the guest room and garage to create room and they never made it back to their spaces or out of the house.

I finally realized I needed help so I looked around online and found Two Organized. From jump (compared to the other companies I contacted) they were on top of what I needed, they offered me options, they did a free in person walkthrough so I could explain what I was looking for, estimates and contract finalization was easy, and scheduling during the holiday season was handled amazingly. My schedule was crazy and changing frequently and they were so gracious with the changes!

The mess: the garage was so full doing laundry was a chore. The before photos don't fully show how packed in the garage was. Honestly Two Organized moved so quickly that I forgot to take a 100% before of the garage. The guestroom before shows just how much stuff was in the room AND both closets were full as well.

They were very clear about what to expect and what I needed to be available for. My part (separating things into keep/donate/trash) was done in about 1-2 hours for the garage and 1 hour for the guest room. The rest was all Tatyana and Svetlana! I cannot say enough amazing things about Celebration Gardens and their incredible team—Gisselle, Brian, and Christian! We worked with them for 2.5 years because we wanted to take our time planning, and they were patient, kind, and understanding every single step of the way. They explained absolutely everything, always responded quickly, and truly helped create our perfect wedding.

From every random idea I had, they were able to bring it to life. The garden itself was stunningly beautiful, but it was the execution that blew us away. "Dancing on the clouds" was a huge priority for me, and it turned out so incredibly magical! Our guests had a blast—the mini-golf was played constantly, and the games, s'mores, and phone booth were massive hits. Because they have outstanding relationships with other vendors, the options they offer are truly endless (everything from dance lessons and magic shows to ice cream bars!).

Planning a wedding can be stressful, but they made the financial part completely stress-free. There were zero surprise fees; every conversation and contract was 100% clear, so we knew exactly what the costs were. Their pricing is incredibly affordable, with packages and deals to fit absolutely any budget. I was able to get my DJ and bartender at reasonable rate.
The first disappointment was that the final setup and décor did not fully match the plans and design vision that were presented during the planning process. When you hire professionals to plan and design an event, you expect the final result to closely reflect what was discussed and promised. While the event looked nice overall, it was not exactly what was envisioned beforehand.

VENUE WAS HOTT!!!

The AC was not turned on early enough to properly cool the building before guests arrived, making the venue extremely hot during the first few hours of the party. Some important guests were unable to attend, and others left early because of the uncomfortable temperature.

NO ACCOUNTABILITY!!!

What was most disappointing was the lack of accountability afterward. We were told the AC was broken, which I felt the AC in smaller rooms, however this issue could have been identified earlier if someone had come in ahead of time to ensure everything was functioning properly. When you're investing a significant amount of money into a venue and event services, you expect proactive management, communication, and ownership when problems arise. People were sweaty, fans were on which caused the fog machine to not work (value of 300). My daughter’s (quinceañera) hair and make up was sweated out ($200) … all this investment down the trash.

I emailed the owner hoping to receive a response or some effort to make things right. Unfortunately, I received no phone call, no apology, and no acknowledgment of how this impacted our event.
The venue is beautiful, and I truly wanted to have a better experience. However, if something goes wrong, don't expect accountability. I've hosted events at other venues before, and this is the only one where I felt there was a lack of professionalism and understanding regarding how their actions affected such an important investment and occasion.

The space itself is lovely, but customer service, execution, and accountability matter just as much as appearance. An organized home provides mental clarity and frees you to focus on the things that matter most because you no longer feel stuck.

Where do I even begin?

I moved to Georgia four years ago and hired another company to organize my home when I first moved in. Over time, as I continued buying things, my home slowly became cluttered. It didn’t happen overnight, but eventually I reached a point where I felt overwhelmed. Every time I wanted to organize, I didn’t know where to start, so nothing happened.

I eventually reached a point where I felt a sense of shame that, as a fully functioning adult with a child, I couldn’t organize my own home. That’s when I reached out to Ashley with Outstanding Organizers.

For some reason, when I look at a cluttered space, my brain just freezes. The rooms were clean, but cluttered. I knew where everything was, but I had no idea where things actually belonged. If you’ve ever experienced that feeling, you know exactly what I mean.

Ashley started with a virtual consultation and created a customized plan for each space. One thing that immediately stood out was her honesty. She noticed I already owned organizing bins and trays and told me she could use what I already had instead of encouraging me to buy more.

I originally thought I needed 16 hours of organizing, but Ashley recommended only 12. She easily could have accepted the extra hours, but instead gave me an honest assessment. Even more impressive, she completed everything in just 8 hours over two visits and encouraged me to save the remaining hours for another project. That level of integrity is rare.

During her first visit, she transformed my pantry, and the difference was unbelievable. Ashley has a true gift for walking into a space and creating systems that are both beautiful and functional. Everything now has a home, nothing feels confusing, and the flow just makes sense.

During her second visit, she tackled my son’s room and closet along with my master closet.

I realized that every time I told my son to clean his room, he genuinely didn’t know where things belonged. Honestly, neither did I. Ashley didn’t just organize his room—she gave him an organizing experience. She coached him through deciding where things should live, labeled his laundry hamper for colors and whites, and even suggested adding a small trash can to his room due the pockets of hidden trash in his room. They were such simple ideas, but things I had never considered. Before Ashley came, he couldn’t even fully open his closet door because there were so many items behind it. Now everything has a designated place, and he told me it feels like a weight has been lifted.

My master closet was very similar. I couldn’t fully open the door because things were piled behind it, and the floor and shelves had become catch-all spaces. Ashley noticed that I already organized my clothes somewhat by color, so she refined the system instead of completely changing it. She organized the floor, the upper shelves, and created a space that is functional, easy to maintain, and now I have a closet I can actually walk into.

What Ashley gave me wasn’t just an organized home—she gave me mental clarity. Instead of feeling overwhelmed every time I looked at a room, I can now focus on spending time with my son, working, exercising, and simply enjoying my home.

Ashley is professional, honest, efficient, and incredibly gifted at what she does. If you’re on the fence about hiring a professional organizer, don’t wait as long as I did. I kept telling myself I could do it on my own to save money, but looking back, hiring Ashley wasn’t an expense—it was an investment in my peace of mind.

Thank you, Ashley, for creating systems that make my home feel peaceful again. [{"Name":"Lovely Marshall","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW5xzO9IXkKc9GnpEVK_Z9FBWjq4w8wzIxvBXLpMLT1yiR3lDRw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Last December, I attended the Small Business Expo at the Atlanta Convention Center at AmericasMart, and I’ll be back again when it returns on December 10, 2025—because when something consistently delivers growth, partnerships, and game-changing insights, it becomes a non-negotiable in your strategy.

As a Forbes Influencer, top e-learning industry provider, and global speaker, I’m always looking for collaborations and clients. The Small Business Expo has been one of the best ways to expand my network and unlock opportunities. In fact, I’ve attended three expos so far and will be at six in 2025, traveling to New York, Miami, Dallas, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Houston. That’s how valuable this event has been for my business!

Here’s what made Atlanta’s event stand out and what you need to know:

The Venue & Atmosphere

It turned what should have been a memorable event into an incredibly stressful and frustrating experience from start to finish.

Communication was a constant problem. Getting clear answers was nearly impossible, and promises made during the planning process simply weren't followed through. By the day of the event, several things we had been assured would be ready either weren't there, weren't completed, or never happened at all.

The venue itself was a major letdown. It looked far more worn, outdated, and poorly maintained than the photos suggest. The cleanliness was disappointing, and the overall condition gave the impression that basic upkeep had been neglected.

My interactions with owner Andrew Tull were also disappointing. In my experience, my concerns were not addressed in a way that made me feel heard, and I left feeling that resolving customer issues was not a priority. When problems arose, I did not feel that adequate steps were taken to make the situation right.

The staff appeared disorganized and unprepared, leaving us to deal with issues that should have been handled by the venue. Instead of enjoying our event, we spent much of our time trying to solve problems ourselves.

On top of that, the bathrooms had no running water for a significant portion of the event. This created a completely unacceptable situation for attendees and staff.

Even more shocking was the fact that the elevators and escalators were not operational while our event was taking place. For a venue hosting guests across multiple floors, this created confusion, accessibility issues, and serious inconvenience for our attendees.

The food service was another major disappointment. The catering quality was extremely mediocre—something you might expect from a basic hotel buffet, not from a venue charging premium event prices. For the amount we paid, the food quality was simply unacceptable.

Parking was another logistical nightmare. Attendees struggled to find parking, and the situation was poorly organized with little guidance provided to guests arriving for the event.

Our group was only around 200 people, which is not a large event by any reasonable standard. Despite this, the management team seemed completely overwhelmed and unprepared to support a group of our size. Basic event coordination and venue operations appeared to be lacking across the board.

Because of these issues, we received the worst attendee feedback we have ever received in the history of our events. Many guests commented on the condition of the facility, the lack of functioning amenities, and the overall disorganization of the venue.

To make matters worse, after the event we were promised refunds due to the numerous problems that occurred. However, three months have now passed and we have not received any refund or meaningful follow-up.

At this point, it feels like the venue management is simply hoping we will stop pursuing the issue.

This venue is severely overpriced for what it offers and clearly not equipped to handle professional events. The experience reflected very poorly on our organization, which is extremely frustrating given how much we paid and what we were promised.

I would strongly recommend that anyone considering hosting an event here look elsewhere. There are many venues that actually maintain their facilities and are capable of delivering a professional experience. Unfortunately, this was not one of them.

They provided a genuine response and the rest is history!","text_translated":"","published_at":"2025-11-23T17:12:01.145966Z"},{"Name":"Linda Loman","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLn1kiRKE4qAtpElKfuXOzxgr-syYLQpEDBbtqrkWEk5D2zvA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Jason and the team at ECG Productions renewed my faith in customer service, offering the expertise and professionalism that so many businesses lack today. I was desperate to find someone that could tackle a video restoration project, rescuing a very old VHS tape that had been trapped in storage for decades. Not only did the team at ECG Productions step in when multiple others said my project was too difficult or impossible, they did so with compassion and a genuine interest in the project and its outcome. As a result, I am going to be able to give my husband the greatest gift imaginable, a chance to see his late father again, hear his voice, and relive moments that will bring his memory alive for the holidays.

My journey began with hope, which diminished rapidly. I scoured the Internet for someone that could help me. We originally wanted to book this venue for a weekday evening wedding reception, and (based on the sales pamphlet and a venue tour), we thought we understood the restrictions and how we would need to adjust to make our plans work. After 1 week of waiting to receive a contract, we were told our dates were unavailable due to scheduled maintenance despite a month's worth of communication prior confirming our date was available.

Our planner worked with them and tried to see if there was any way we could get our dates, since we loved the gardens and the design of the atrium, and it already fit the visual look we were going for, and then they delivered a contract. Contrary to their sales pamphlet's promised 3 hour event, and the tour's advice that events start "after 6", our contract offered a 2.5 hour event which was not allowed to start any sooner than 6:30. Even if we'd contracted for an extra hour, which we had originally planned to do, that would still have only been 3.5 hours, and barely enough time for the vendors to load out if everything went smoothly.

I'd have loved to have a reception at this venue, truly, but they simply cannot deliver on what their sales pamphlet promises for a weekday event, unless you're willing to work with an incredibly tight schedule and pay extra to make sure you have enough time for your vendors to strike and load out. If we'd gotten these details in the venue site tour, or in any of our emails (including when we asked for a 6 pm event start time which they did not reject), we simply wouldn't have wasted our, or our planner's, time trying to negotiate for this to be the venue for our reception.

We're lucky we had a backup venue already in mind, and have already signed a contract with them, because this has been an overall deeply disappointing experience and I'd honestly advise no one book an event on a weekday unless you need your event to last less than two hours. I understand that there are limitations on certain things, but those were not communicated during the multiple opportunities where a 6 pm event start was mentioned or at any point until the contract We cannot express enough how friendly, organized, and professional these women are.
We selected the Month-of-Coordination package for our celebration at The Conservatory at Blackberry Ridge.

We were already so impressed after our initial consultation with Jenny, however a bit apprehensive to hear that she was already booked for our date and that we'd be assigned to another team member. We can’t emphasize enough how wrong we were!! We worked with Abby who appeased any and all of our concerns immediately!

She routinely checked in with us and kept us on track, she asked us extremely detailed questions so that she could understand our vision for the day. Two months ahead of our wedding date, Abby took over everything, including handling all of the vendor coordination, all of the payment dates, and any communication with the venue that was required. She provided several extremely detailed itineraries: one couple-specific, one bridal party-specific, and one vendor-specific. The whole day was planned down to the minute. We all knew when /where we needed to be at all times.

Neither us nor our family members had to worry about anything that went wrong the day of, the BTV team had handled.

Little background - My husband and I had already eloped and were just hiring the company to do a small reception for 75 people. No ceremony was involved so the amount of set up/break down they had to do was minimal compared to a traditional wedding.

A few months prior to our reception, I was in a bind to find someone to help with design/decorations. Our catering manager put us in touch with a member of the design team. I let her know that my husband and I both work in healthcare and really don't have time to hash out fine details and be super involved in the process. Our goal was to find someone we meshed well with and have them run with the inspiration we provided. Unfortunately, I think our lack of direct oversight was what led to us being completely taken advantage of.

Upon our initial conversation, Annie seemed very confident in the plan and was open with me about pricing. She let me know they have a $5,000 minimum for design. I agreed because I was already in a rush to find someone and she seemed to assure me that she understood where we were coming from and would make it worth our while. Unfortunately, that was not the case at all. During our final walkthrough at the venue, our coordinator asked her what the design plan was and she responded by saying, "I really don't have a lot". At the end of the meeting, I addressed her and basically tried to set the expectation that if we are paying a $5,000 minimum, we hope to see a full design plan (i.e. lots of greenery, etc). I think she was offended because she became defensive saying that her name was attached to the design and she wouldn't want to tarnish her reputation...She also told us that we would need to pay for extra time to set up the café lights we wanted, otherwise they would still be setting up when guests arrive (which is unacceptable in my opinion). They originally had a 3 hour window to implement the design plan...Not only did we pay extra for the design team to open the venue at 2pm instead, giving them a 4 hour window, but we had to pay the venue as well for the additional time.

The design 'team' (not including Annie) did not show up to the venue until 4:30pm, 2 and a half hours late... The lights were not hung according to the proposal and took all of 30 minutes to hang, as opposed to the several hours she quoted us originally. The décor for our reception consisted of 13 table linens, tiny floral arrangements, 2 rugs, a few strands of café lights, and some votives. I had to purchase all of our signs, table numbers, etc. separately which I think is utterly ridiculous for the amount of money we paid. We didn't let the disappointment of this mishap ruin our reception, but it is really unfortunate that there are people in this industry that do not take pride in their work and will absolutely rob you blind if you let them.

[{"Name":"Sophia Nyman","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJtDDeivQxhTUmeYlTZH2EipsD6YuuiWfsRqeUW1Ba5zoYf_w=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Upstairs Atlanta is our favorite and venue in Atlanta. From the planning process all the way through our wedding day, the entire experience was incredible. The space itself is beautiful, intimate, and full of character, but what really made it special was the team behind it.

Kelsey and the owners are fabulous, down to earth, and experts in event planning. All venue staff were incredibly kind, accommodating, responsive, and genuinely invested in making sure our day was exactly what we envisioned. Kelsey was our coordinator and she was absolutely amazing and made the entire wedding day feel like a breeze. She was organized, attentive, calm, and always seemed to be one step ahead of everything that needed to happen. There are so many moving pieces on a wedding day, and knowing Kelsey had everything handled allowed us to completely relax, be present, and actually enjoy every moment instead of worrying about logistics or what needed to happen next. The location is absolutely beautiful, and when a large event is planned you get to stay at the residential location for an amazing rate. [THE LOCATION]
What can you say, once you have the chance to see the location, it is beyond words. Not a little strip mall location nor a random building in the middle of the city, but a beautiful sea side venue with breathtaking views where you can enjoy the marina, the sunset, and the Miami skyline.

When you have friends/guests constantly tell you, that the food at Ciara's quinces was one for the books, that is a sign. We are constantly reminded that the quality and quantity of the food was superb. For our event we had a buffet style arrangement, with food choices only seen at high end restaurants..boy do I miss that Salmon. We had a wide variety of meats, pastas, dishes, with a grand finally of exquisite desserts. With a variety of dishes that satisfied vegetarians and non alike. STAFF]
Our daughter, my wife, and I spent a considerable amount of time looking for the best venue for our daughter's Quinces. Nelly (event manager) and Harry (operations manager) were not just business associates, they became family. We visited many potential venues, however once we met the staff at Briza's, we knew that the decision was done. We really appreciate the responsiveness and care that they took for our event. Returned all of our calls and inquires and always available to help with our process.
[THE ACCOMMODATION]
The location is absolutely beautiful, and when a large event is planned you get to stay at the residential location for an amazing rate. Being so close to the venue, and being able to go back and forth from our 3 bedroom fully furnished apartment was amazing. We checked in the day before, and stayed till the day after, it made the total experience phenomenal. We did not want to leave.
[THE LOCATION]
What can you say, once you have the chance to see the location, it is beyond words. Not a little strip mall location nor a random building in the middle of the city, but a beautiful sea side venue with breathtaking views where you can enjoy the marina, the sunset, and the Miami skyline.
[THE FOOD]
When you have friends/guests constantly tell you, that the food at Ciara's quinces was one for the books, that is a sign. We are constantly reminded that the quality and quantity of the food was superb. For our event we had a buffet style arrangement, with food choices only seen at high end restaurants..boy do I miss that Salmon. We had a wide variety of meats, pastas, dishes, with a grand finally of exquisite desserts. With a variety of dishes that satisfied vegetarians and non alike. The bar service and liquor was outstanding, and constantly flowing. The staff service was professional and seamless, they were there to attend to every little need and detail.
[OVERALL]
The whole experience was hands off, and the event managers handled everything!! All we we needed to do was to relax and enjoy our event. This will be an experience that my daughter, family and friends (Nelly and Harry included) will cherish forever. Our family thanks the staff at Briza's from the bottom of our hearts.

If you need a venue with prime location, seamless navigation, and a polished event setup, the Miami Airport Convention Center should be at the top of your list.

1️⃣ Spacious & Well-Designed for Large Events

This venue is HUGE—seriously, wear comfortable shoes because you’ll be walking a lot. The layout balances a high-energy trade show vibe with intimate networking spaces.

✔️ Wide aisles & well-spaced booths for smooth traffic flow.
✔️ Staff stationed throughout ensured attendees never felt lost.

A standout feature was that exhibitors weren’t just showcasing their businesses—they were also leading workshops and keynotes, making it easy to connect beyond the sales pitch.

2️⃣ VIP Networking & Happy Hour – Well-Executed

✔️ A dedicated bar area added a high-end touch.
✔️ A curated dessert selection that made the experience even better.

Unlike cities where networking felt like an afterthought, this venue made it feel premium.

3️⃣ Finding food at conferences can be a nightmare—not here. Miami NAILED it.

✔️ Cafeteria inside the event space—no long walks to grab food.
✔️ Unlike Houston & Atlanta, where food was far away, here, it was steps away.
✔️ Attendees stayed engaged longer without leaving the venue.

4️⃣ The Missed Opportunity: Private Networking Spaces

While the VIP networking was strong, it lacked the exclusivity that high-level attendees expect.

💡 Why Houston did it better:
✔️ A private networking room created an intimate setting for high-value conversations.
✔️ Less background noise meant meaningful discussions.

💡 Where Miami can improve:
❌ The networking section was in an open area—too noisy to connect deeply.
❌ VIPs pay extra for exclusivity, and a private setting would have enhanced that experience.
❌ There were empty private rooms upstairs that could have been used.

5️⃣ Strong Branding & Signage for a Polished Look

✔️ Strategic placement of backdrops made for great photos.
✔️ Clear branding & directions enhanced the attendee experience.
✔️ The layout felt immersive and easy to navigate.

The only drawback was Uber & GPS drop-off locations. Right now, GPS directs attendees to the DoubleTree Hotel entrance, requiring a long walk.

Pro tip: When arriving, ask to be dropped off at the hotel circle instead—it’s the fastest way inside.

6️⃣ The One Big Issue… It Was FREEZING 🥶

The main trade show floor was ice-cold.
Upstairs rooms were fine, likely due to different flooring.
❄️ Better temperature zoning is needed to improve attendee comfort.

If you’re attending, bring a sweater.

Final Thoughts – Should You Host Your Event Here? 100% YES.

From a logistics, branding, and attendee experience standpoint, this venue is one of the best. Whether you’re planning a trade show, business networking event, or corporate gathering, this space offers prime location, seamless navigation, and top-tier convenience.

Why the Miami Airport Convention Center Should Be Your Next Event Venue

If you need a venue with prime location, seamless navigation, and a polished event setup, the Miami Airport Convention Center should be at the top of your list.

1️⃣ Spacious & Well-Designed for Large Events

This venue is HUGE—seriously, wear comfortable shoes because you’ll be walking a lot. The layout balances a high-energy trade show vibe with intimate networking spaces.

✔️ Wide aisles & well-spaced booths for smooth traffic flow.
✔️ Staff stationed throughout ensured attendees never felt lost.

A standout feature was that exhibitors weren’t just showcasing their businesses—they were also leading workshops and keynotes, making it easy to connect beyond the sales pitch.

2️⃣ VIP Networking & Happy Hour – Well-Executed

✔️ A dedicated bar area added a high-end touch.
✔️ A curated dessert selection that made the experience even better.

Unlike cities where networking felt like an afterthought, this venue made it feel premium.

3️⃣ Finding food at conferences can be a nightmare—not here. Miami NAILED it.

✔️ Cafeteria inside the event space—no long walks to grab food.
✔️ Unlike Houston & Atlanta, where food was far away, here, it was steps away.
✔️ Attendees stayed engaged longer without leaving the venue.

4️⃣ The Missed Opportunity: Private Networking Spaces

While the VIP networking was strong, it lacked the exclusivity that high-level attendees expect.

💡 Why Houston did it better:
✔️ A private networking room created an intimate setting for high-value conversations.
✔️ Less background noise meant meaningful discussions.

💡 Where Miami can improve:
❌ The networking section was in an open area—too noisy to connect deeply.
❌ VIPs pay extra for exclusivity, and a private setting would have enhanced that experience.
❌ There were empty private rooms upstairs that could have been used.

5️⃣ Strong Branding & Signage for a Polished Look

✔️ Strategic placement of backdrops made for great photos.
✔️ Clear branding & directions enhanced the attendee experience.
✔️ The layout felt immersive and easy to navigate.

The only drawback was Uber & GPS drop-off locations. Right now, GPS directs attendees to the DoubleTree Hotel entrance, requiring a long walk.

Pro tip: When arriving, ask to be dropped off at the hotel circle instead—it’s the fastest way inside.

6️⃣ The One Big Issue… It Was FREEZING 🥶

The main trade show floor was ice-cold.
Upstairs rooms were fine, likely due to different flooring.
❄️ Better temperature zoning is needed to improve attendee comfort.

If you’re attending, bring a sweater.

Final Thoughts – Should You Host Your Event Here? 100% YES.

From a logistics, branding, and attendee experience standpoint, this venue is one of the best. Whether you’re planning a trade show, business networking event, or corporate gathering, this space offers prime location, seamless navigation, and top-tier convenience.

A few small tweaks—like creating a more private networking space, adjusting temperature control, and clarifying drop-off directions—would make the experience flawless. But overall, if you’re considering where to host your next event, this venue should absolutely be on your list.

When Zach and I first found Micro Miami, we weren't just looking for a vendor, we were looking for proof that what we imagined could actually exist. We'd been to enough weddings to know the difference between one that's fine and one that stays with you. The kind where you're a guest and you still feel like you're inside someone's love story. Where the design, the feeling, the sheer intention of it all just pulls you in. When we saw your work, we knew. They get it.

But what you may not fully know is what this wedding meant for me specifically. Cancelling the first wedding and with it, a design and a dream I had poured everything in, left a mark. Doing this again took real trust on my part. And you earned every bit of it.

From the moment we met Donata, to Sofia returning, to the way you run your business - the transparency, the professionalism, the vendors, the pricing, the way you actually listened  when we weren't seeing eye to eye on something - it all just fell into place. You made us feel like the whole thing was possible.

Now that it's over, I keep coming back to this: I genuinely believe this wedding was meant to be exactly what it was. The universe had a plan for Zach and me — and part of that plan was the first wedding not happening, so that this one could. Because what you all created was beyond anything I could have dreamed. IT WAS PERFECT! A wedding out of a fairytale and for a princess. Every single guest has reached out. Best wedding they've ever been to. Best food. Most fun. MOST BEAUTIFUL!!!! I'm still getting texts. And to me, that's everything - that's the whole point. To give the people we love a pinch me moment in the middle of our pinch me moment.

You gave me something else, too: I got to actually be there. I didn't spend my wedding day as the stressed bride managing logistics in my head. I was present. I danced. I laughed. I admittedly badly bruised my toe being crazy on the dance floor. And the fact that I got to be that version of myself on that night? That matters more to me than I can say.

If I could live it again, I wouldn't change a single thing. Not one. (Except, possibly, bruising my toe doing the splits 🤪.)

You two  are the definition of true partners. What you do is nothing short of extraordinary, and I mean that in the most literal sense. Your talent, your vision, your execution, your heart for the work - it's rare. You deserve to be booked every weekend for as long as you want to be in business, and I will say exactly that to anyone who asks.

On behalf of Zach and me: thank you. You made our dreams real. You gave us the most beautiful beginning to this next chapter of our lives. And this will absolutely not be the last time we work together! Our friends and family have already made it very clear that a ten-year anniversary party is not going to be soon enough and we need to plan for five years, maybe less. And when the Theis family grows, you'll be our go to for baby showers etc..

We love you both so much, and we are eternally grateful - not just for the wedding you gave us, but for the experience you gave our guests, and for the feeling that Zach and I now get to carry in our hearts and souls for the rest of our lives.
